# Parameter keys of Heimat 0.10.0: those of 0.8.0 plus Pattern and the
# looper controls. A key is never renamed or removed, and an enum never loses
# options or changes their order, so saved sessions and patches keep working.
# Columns: key type options
gene_size float 0
slide float 0
morph float 0
vari_speed float 0
organize float 0
volume float 0
pad_mode enum 3
play_mode enum 3

root_note int 0

splice_base int 0
splice_source enum 2
divide int 0

mcr1 float 0
mcr2 float 0
mcr3 float 0
sos float 0
in_gain enum 4
rec_source enum 2

clock_source enum 4
clock_div enum 5
bpm int 0
clock_mode enum 3
mute enum 2
save_48k enum 2
scatter float 0
spread float 0
width float 0
threshold float 0
thr_mode enum 3
eq_low float 0

eq_freq float 0
eq_high float 0
rev_size float 0
rev_predelay float 0
